Every number (basis and footer lines too) is the filtered count: sessions unique, in window, on the named work; a raw file count is never a session count (exports: `sessions --dir <folder> --since D --until D`, count the `sessionRows` kept); not computed is not zero, write no number. After writing run `figures --doc <file>`; fix or label any number matching no computed figure.

Northwind Logistics keeps electronic records of shipments, called manifests: lists of what is being sent, to whom, and when. Staff and other systems need to look things up in those records, produce invoices from them, and exchange data with older systems.
